items.title: If It’s Electronic Paper, Why Not Print To It?
items.summary: Hackaday covers an ESP32-C3 Xteink e-paper reader fork that implements Internet Printing Protocol, letting computers send documents to the reader as if it were a printer while also saving output to SD card.

items.title: A Split Keyboard Designed For Human Hands
items.summary: A compact 36-key split keyboard was designed around measured hand geometry and refined through roughly 50 prototypes, using angled finger columns, low-profile switches, and thumb layer keys.

items.title: Letting an AI agent work on your notes without uploading them
items.summary: Pellet describes a local-first approach to letting an AI agent work directly with personal markdown notes on the user’s machine instead of requiring the knowledge base to be uploaded to a hosted service.

items.title: Best Private and Local-First Task Apps in 2026
items.summary: A comparison of private and local-first task apps focusing on where data lives, whether accounts are required, sync and encryption models, export options, and how offline-first claims differ from true local-first capture.

items.title: Local-first Software
items.summary: A recent note explains local-first software as keeping the primary truth on the device, with sync treated as optional infrastructure, and connects that idea to privacy, data sovereignty, offline use, and PKM.

items.title: Latest News | Pokemon.com
items.summary: The official Pokémon news page currently highlights September 2026 updates across games and the Trading Card Game, including 30th Celebration coverage, Pokopia expansion-pass information, and Pokémon GO updates.

items.title: ニュース一覧 | ポケモンカードゲーム公式ホームページ
items.summary: ポケモンカードゲーム公式のニュース一覧。9月11日にはチャンピオンズリーグ2027横浜のライブ配信や学園祭2026、9月9日には30th CELEBRATION関連情報などが掲載されている。
items.source: ポケモンカードゲーム

items.title: Raspberry Pi 5 Cyberdeck – DIY Handheld with Powerbank #3DThursday #3DPrinting
items.summary: Adafruit highlights a Raspberry Pi 5 handheld cyberdeck with a high-resolution display, replaceable power-bank power, exposed Mini HDMI, and a 3D-printable enclosure designed for programming, deployment, and network work.

items.title: Small E-Ink Device For IoT Projects
items.summary: Electronics For You covers M5Stack PaperMono, an ESP32-S3R8 handheld with a 3.97-inch grayscale touch E-Ink display, frontlight, LoRa, NFC, microSD, RTC, IMU, Wi-Fi, and a built-in 1150mAh battery.

items.title: Even without Winds and Waves, Pokemon just had its best ever year with $3.4 billion in net sales probably thanks to Pokopia, FireRed and LeafGreen
items.summary: GamesRadar reports that The Pokémon Company posted record 2026 results, citing roughly $3.4 billion in net sales and strong performance from releases including Pokémon Pokopia and the Switch versions of FireRed and LeafGreen.

items.title: Competitive Pokémon is on phones now, but you still need a Switch to become a champion
items.summary: The Verge examines Pokémon Champions on mobile and Switch, noting that cross-platform play is supported but top-level championship competition still requires Switch hardware, despite the mobile version’s broad reach.

items.title: With Pokemon Bank's demise on the horizon, one modder makes their own adapter to move Pokemon from GBA to Switch consoles
items.summary: A hobbyist built a homebrew adapter that transfers Pokémon between Game Boy Advance hardware and Switch consoles, an experimental preservation path as Pokémon Bank approaches its announced 2027 shutdown.

items.title: Pokémon Horizons Anime Teams up with Pokémon GO Mobile Game for 150th Episode
items.summary: Crunchyroll reports a Pokémon Horizons and Pokémon GO collaboration tied to the anime’s 150th episode, with the episode scheduled for September 18 and connected in-game content featuring Friede-themed elements.

items.title: 【秋の睡眠健康週間・ぐっすりの日】『Pokémon Sleep』の「#ポケモンとねむる」の最新情報を一挙公開！
items.summary: 株式会社ポケモンは9月1日、Pokémon Sleepの秋企画を発表。全国睡眠県グランプリ2026、NOT A HOTELとの宿泊企画、Fitbit Airとのコラボなど、睡眠を軸にした複数施策を公開した。
items.source: 株式会社ポケモン / PR TIMES
